sources.facts: The preset form {name, maps[].{fileName, channels[].{destChannel, srcChannel, srcMapType, srcMapName}, parameters}}; the documentMap names basecolor, opacity, roughness, metallic, emissive and specularweight; the virtualMap names AO_Mixed and Normal_DirectX; the $mesh and $textureSet wildcards.

sources.page: Unreal Engine 5.6 documentation, texture import and texture properties (approved source X-CONSUMERS)
sources.section: Texture sRGB flag and compression settings; occlusion-roughness-metallic packing; normal maps; DDS 2D import
sources.facts: Colour textures (base colour, emissive) are sampled with the sRGB flag; packed data textures (occlusion in R, roughness in G, metallic in B) and normal maps without it; the engine's tangent-space normal maps follow the DirectX convention (green as -v); DDS 2D textures are importable, and BC pass-through through cooking is not documented (docs/analysis/technology-options/05-review-response.md finding 13).

sources.page: UzPainter decision 023 (owner answer Q10); docs/architecture/08-export.md §4 Unreal Engine (Packed)
sources.section: UE 5.6 target, encodings and the SpecularWeight consumer gap
sources.facts: Target UE 5.6; PNG/TGA 8-bit by default and an optional DDS variant (BC7 BaseColor, ORM and Emissive, BC5 Normal); SpecularWeight exported as a separate map and reported in the receipt as a consumer gap, its mapping Specular = 0.5 x SpecularWeight left to the consumer.

sources.page: Recording R-322 (decision 322): export-presets-unreal-packed-legacy and -ocio, Painter 12.2.0, on the UzmiGames-authored bevelled cube
sources.section: ResourceExportPreset.list_output_maps of the versioned starter-assets URL; dry-run lists and exports of five configurations, r1 and r2
sources.facts: Confirms, never sources: the URL resource://starter_assets/Unreal Engine (Packed)?version=8339356058946582545.spexp; four maps BaseColor (RGB baseColor, A opacity), OcclusionRoughnessMetallic (R AO_Mixed, G roughness, B metallic), Normal (Normal_DirectX) and Emissive (emissive), each named $mesh_$textureSet_<map>(_$colorSpace)(.$udim) at PNG 8, dithering on the Normal only; no padding (own parameters raise 'padding algorithm could not be resolved'); no SpecularWeight map; under OCIO the names end _sRGB (BaseColor, Emissive) and _Raw (OcclusionRoughnessMetallic, Normal); TGA 8 files equal the PNG 8 files in decoded values on every map, r1 = r2.

packing.decision: RGB from documentMap basecolor, A from documentMap opacity (dropped when the stack has no opacity channel, probe P7); the colour is written in its channel's encoding (an sRGB8 BaseColor sRGB-encoded, decision 126); PNG 8, no dithering
packing.source: 08-export.md §4 (RGB basecolor, A opacity); UE 5.6 texture import (base colour sampled sRGB); decision 023 (8-bit default); confirmed by R-322

packing.decision: R from virtualMap AO_Mixed, G from documentMap roughness, B from documentMap metallic, linear; PNG 8, no dithering; AO_Mixed is computed in decisions 411, 418 and 419's scope and refused outside it
packing.source: 08-export.md §4 (R AO_Mixed, G roughness, B metallic, linear); UE 5.6 ORM packing (occlusion R, roughness G, metallic B, no sRGB); confirmed by R-322

packing.decision: RGB from virtualMap Normal_DirectX, linear; PNG 8 with dithering (an export that keeps it is refused until dithering is fitted, item 2.9)
packing.source: 08-export.md §4 (Normal_DirectX); UE 5.6 normal maps (DirectX convention); confirmed by R-322

packing.decision: RGB from documentMap emissive, written in its channel's encoding; PNG 8, no dithering; absent when the stack has no emissive channel (decision 091)
packing.source: 08-export.md §4 (_Emissive); UE 5.6 texture import (emissive sampled sRGB); confirmed by R-322

packing.decision: UzPainter extension: L from documentMap specularweight, written when the stack has the channel (an absent documentMap makes the map absent, decision 091); PNG 8, no dithering; the receipt reports it as a consumer gap. Painter's preset writes no such file (R-322, which has the channel); this is not a Painter parity claim.
packing.source: decision 023; 08-export.md §4 (a separate _SpecularWeight map, Specular = 0.5 x SpecularWeight belongs to the consumer); R-322 (Painter writes four maps)

packing.decision: The reference is the starter-assets URL R-322 observed; the preset sets no padding (an export without an exportParameters padding is refused, as Painter raises); exportParameters override the maps' format, depth and dithering. TGA 8 holds the PNG 8 codes (R-322: equal in decoded values on all four maps, Legacy and OCIO). The DDS variant is the separate preset unreal-engine-packed-dds (decision 322).

pending.what: Layout, names, URL and the preset's own parameters confirmed by R-322 Legacy/OCIO r1/r2. Decoded parity on the three pilots is item 3.1 (their Unreal goldens under EXC-013 and EXC-014); Painter's own PNG 8 defaults dither the Normal (item 2.9); SpecularWeight is a deliberate UzPainter extension with no Painter counterpart.
